turns.question: Why did we switch sessions to JWT, and who did it?
turns.text:
**Why:** The server-side session table was the main source of database load. Issue #11, opened by dave, reported p95 DB CPU hitting 90% at login peaks with a hot sessions table [2]. The PR replaced server-side sessions with short-lived JWTs. Refresh tokens stay server-side [1]. The auth design doc says the same: 15-minute JWTs, server-side refresh tokens, and a decision made in #1 after the DB load issue #11 [3].

**Who:** alice authored PR #1, "feat(auth): switch sessions to JWT". It is merged and closes #11 [1].
